tasks.title: Natural frequency of a board mount
tasks.solution: The grommets act in parallel: k_total = 4k. f₀ = (1/2π)·√(k_total/m), with the mass in kilograms. For the mount to damp vibration, f₀ must be 3–5 times below the frequency you are damping (as in the module); at a frequency ratio below √2 the mount amplifies it.

tasks.title: When the motor hits the frame resonance
tasks.solution: The motor's fundamental harmonic is f = RPM/60, so RPM = 60·f. At this speed the resonance builds up: the peak in the spectrum grows at this throttle point and stays put at others — the sign of the frame, not the motor.
